outlet: Kittitas County Auditor, sample ballot, November 3, 2026 General Election
notes: Official Kittitas County sample ballot for the 2026 General Election (3 printed pages), linked as 'November 2026 General Sample ballot' from the Ballot Measures & Resolutions table of https://www.co.kittitas.wa.us/auditor/elections/current/default.aspx, whose General election row lists no resolutions. The ballot prints the three statewide measures, CD 8, LD 13 (Senator, Pos. 1, Pos. 2), the eight county offices, the five Supreme Court seats, Court of Appeals Div. 3 Dist. 3 Pos. 1, District Court Judge Lower County and Upper County, and Public Utility District No. 1 Commissioner, District 1; no local measures. Text extracted to interim/pdf-text/sample-ballot.txt.
